long_biography.plain_text:
In 1976, brothers David and José Daniel redirected an established textile business toward construction, creating Grupo Danhos around income-producing urban property. David had studied architecture at Mexico’s National Autonomous University and became closely involved in acquisitions, project finance, development, administration and risk management. Early schemes established a model centred on complex sites in metropolitan Mexico.

The group later expanded across retail centres, office towers and mixed-use complexes, then listed Fibra Danhos on Mexico’s stock exchange in 2013. David has chaired the trust’s Technical Committee since its formation, retaining strategic oversight without a day-to-day executive post. A second generation later assumed chief-executive responsibility; that successor mandate is distinct from David’s founder-chairman role.
